source.snippet: Unsloth Studio doesn't keep track of locally loaded model, thinks I have to stop generation to load the model that is loaded. GPU 0: AMD Radeon PRO W7900 · 45 GiB, GPU 1: AMD Radeon PRO W7500 · 8 GiB. If I have a chat that was loaded with a cloud model and then I go to 'on Device' and try to select the model that is currently loaded locally (that I know is loaded), it still prompts me to stop generation to load the model. [Second issue] Model in Coding scope thinks its absolute path is /tmp when it isn't — asked a model to do pwd after asking another model to edit code and it couldn't tell me where it was looking.

problem_statement: Users running local LLM inference on high-end workstation GPUs face broken state management in local LLM UIs — the tool loses track of which model is loaded and where files are located, causing repeated interruptions and wasted GPU spin-up time in multi-model workflows.
target_segment: ML practitioners and AI engineers running local LLM inference on workstation-class GPUs (AMD/NVIDIA), typically at small companies or as independent consultants.
notes: Single user but with AMD Radeon PRO W7900 (~$3,500 GPU) + W7500 setup — clear capital investment signals a serious practitioner or small studio, not a hobbyist. Two distinct bugs filed same day suggest active daily use and paid workflow dependency. Pain: multi-model switching in local UIs is unreliable, forcing manual intervention. A reliable local LLM session manager / state tracker could be a paid tool for this segment. Buyer evidence: hardware investment implies professional use context.
